description: opencode plugin: adds a 'CliProxy' login that routes the native Anthropic provider through a self-hosted CLIProxyAPI endpoint, with a connection check. Pure proxy: no OAuth dependency, the client sends only an api-key and the proxy handles Anthropic auth

detail.description_zh: opencode 插件：添加了一个 'CliProxy' 登录，它通过自托管的 CLIProxyAPI 端点路由原生 Anthropic 提供程序，并带有连接检查。纯代理：没有 OAuth 依赖，客户端只发送 api-key，代理处理 Anthropic 身份验证
